Docs.summary: Thin typed event relay for Voice Live Bridge Protocol 1.0.
Docs.remarks: Callbacks are awaited in wire order. Applications that need work to outlive a callback create, track, cancel, and observe their own tasks; the relay retains no application work or cross-message protocol state.

Docs.param: The accepted . The SDK has already called AcceptWebSocketAsync; the handler owns the full-duplex lifecycle from this point. On clean return the SDK closes the connection with RFC 6455 code 1000 (NormalClosure); an unhandled exception is mapped to code 1011 (InternalServerError); a handler-initiated CloseAsync is preserved unchanged.

Per-connection context. The session ID honours FOUNDRY_AGENT_SESSION_ID (matching the HTTP POST /invocations precedence, minus the query-param override which has no ergonomic equivalent on a long-lived WS connection). The invocation ID is a generated UUID — WebSocket has no per-message invocation ID.
Cancelled when the connection is aborted (client disconnect, server shutdown, request aborted, etc.).
Docs.returns: A task representing the async lifetime of the connection.
